items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We played... when we left New York... And then Pancho was singing, Pancho Higgard

ctx.x: No. Let me say this. No. We played -- we played [scatting], we played "Things to Come", we played the library. Because, look, in the Apollo Theater -- not the Apollo Theater -­ the Savoy Ballroom [phonetic sp.], we'd go up -- the people couldn't wait for us to get up there 'cause, see, if you know how to dance, like everything we played, you'd dance to it. We played [scatting] and the people would be off timing. Oh, man! Like I don't care how fast or slow something would be played, they could dance to it and they…
